description: Every compute host function, once. Server dispatchers, the capability summary, the SDK parity gate and the CrowdyJS browser broker are all checked against this file (DN-10: grid scope = app scope intersected with grid confinement).

groups.model: Game Model containers, properties, edges and function invocation
groups.state: Durable user / avatar / grid state blobs

functions.name: container_create
functions.grid: Created on the player tier, owned by the executing identity and tagged with the grid

functions.grid: Only containers the executing identity owns on this grid; others are unavailable

functions.app: Up to 32 containers in the app
functions.grid: Up to 32 owned containers on this grid; foreign ids are silently absent
